claims.text: The last-digit check (product ends in 8) matches the claimed value, so it does not distinguish the two numbers.
The mod-9 check expects the product to be 2 mod 9.
The computed value 3,233,051,948 has digit sum 38, which is 2 mod 9, consistent with the expected residue.
The claimed value 3,233,052,048 has digit sum 30, which is 3 mod 9, so it fails the mod-9 check.
The claimed value differs from the true product by 100.
The matching last digit is the only point in favor of YES, and it is weak.
The direct computation settles the question.
